category_edits.rationale: Scale each NextItNet block’s residual update by 0.5 across all four category models to reduce accumulated convolutional updates. The generated predictor imports the modified model class directly, preserving architecture and checkpoint consistency without writer changes. All other settings remain fixed.

response.change_summary: Apply fixed 0.5 residual scaling to every causal convolution block, retaining one NextItNet checkpoint per category.
